implementation.summary: Scope existing twelve-loop receipt schema and durable store with explicit tenant_id and environment before producer/read integration. Preserves honest legacy unscoped rows without invented provenance, enforces zero cross-tenant leakage, isolates unscoped legacy reduction from scoped partitions, provides non-lossy 002 rollback and pre-003 source compatibility, and establishes fresh-process restart and rebuild equivalence.
implementation.current_fix: Resolved Codex2 review rejection P1 (1)-(3) acceptance defects: (1) Scoped TwelveLoopProjector._receipts cache identity by (tenant_id, environment, receipt_id) and bound both store.get_receipt lookups (pre-check and post-persist verification) to receipt scope. Allows distinct scoped projectors sharing PostgreSQL to process identical event IDs across tenants without cross-scope collision, ensures cold replay (auto_load=False) resolves the matching scoped partition without legacy NULL-scope collision, while preserving wrong-caller-scope and within-scope release/correlation/loop/type conflict rejection. (2) TwelveLoopStore.get_receipt (Memory and Postgres sync/async) now defaults to all_scopes=False and validates caller scope at entrance, failing closed (ValueError) on partial scope, protecting tenant receipts from unscoped callers, and querying exact legacy rows when unscoped. (3) 003_scope_twelve_loop_truth_receipts.sql backup restoration DO block checks all receipt semantic fields (receipt_type, loop_id, correlation_id, release_id, owner, provenance, status, observed_at, degradation_reason, causation_id, payload) and all 15 observation semantic fields against backup tables using IS DISTINCT FROM, failing closed and preserving backup tables transactionally on any semantic difference.
implementation.regressions: PostgreSQL migration 002-to-003 upgrade and honest legacy row preservation, unscoped legacy reduction isolation from tenant receipts, non-lossy rollback to 002 and pre-003 source compatibility, pre-003 replay of identical receipt ID during rollback without data loss, fresh-process child-process restart and rebuild equivalence, multi-tenant streaming, cross-tenant collision allowance across isolated scopes, within-scope collision rejection, out-of-order delivery with provenance fencing, and fail-closed full-semantic backup restoration on conflicting content.
implementation.boundary: Scoped receipt schema, storage, and read models only; no hosted deployment, no production-data migration, no credential changes, no second store or projector.
implementation.rollback_plan: Execute rollback_to_002_schema_sync() or await rollback_to_002_schema(): archives scoped receipts to loop_receipts_scoped_backup, archives scoped observations to twelve_loop_observations_scoped_backup, drops scoped indexes, and restores twelve_loop_observations_pkey on (release_id, correlation_id, loop_id) and loop_receipts_pkey on (receipt_id). Allows pre-003 store and projector code to run with complete receipt and observation isolation without UniqueViolation or InvalidColumnReference. Forward re-migration 003 automatically restores all backed-up scoped receipts and observations without data loss, failing closed on conflicting content.

verification.collection: Every listed batch was run in bounded foreground execution and terminal exit status was collected.
